name: BARMM area outlines
note: SVG path data in a 1000-unit-wide frame, equirectangular with the longitude corrected at the frame's middle latitude. Framed on the Mindanao island group. Simplified outlines: good enough to recognize a province, not good enough to settle where one ends.

source.label: PSA — Philippine Standard Geographic Code, 2023 edition
